static_traits.name: Li Weihang
static_traits.social_status: Having a few close friends, but rarely discussing Social anxiety and Self-doubt with them due to shame
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no past psychotherapy or psychiatric visits
static_traits.language_features: Clear thinking, fluent expression, able to identify 'this is just a feeling/assumption without evidence', good self-Reflection ability; tense and cautious emotionally, highly cooperative, with self-reproach tendency

basic_info.main_problem: I always feel others hold negative judgments of me, which leads to Social anxiety and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because Social anxiety has begun affecting my Work performance and Interpersonal relationships, and I want to solve these problems; I want to change my thinking patterns because I know these thoughts are not helpful.
growth_experiences: A few years ago at a party, making a comment he thought was funny but getting silence, triggering on-the-spot embarrassment and strong shame. Since then repeatedly recalling the event, subjectively believing 'everyone remembers and negatively evaluates me for it', gradually forming expectations and vigilance of being negatively judged in social and Work settings, Social anxiety gradually worsening, affecting speaking and participation. When problems first appeared, accompanied by Work pressure and personal insecurity, tension was moderate.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent.
If others see my mistakes or imperfection, my worth will be negated.

special_situations.event: Tripping while running into celebrity Jimmy Fallon on the street
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I embarrass myself in public, others will think I am an idiot and remember me for a long time
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to lower his presence, quickly leaving the scene, afterwards repeatedly Reflecting and blaming himself to 'prevent recurrence'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He must think I am a fool.

special_situations.event: When needing to speak in work meetings or being watched by colleagues / superiors
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot express perfectly and immediately give the best answer, it proves I am not competent at this Work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Speaking less, Over-preparation of outlines, hiding in the team to avoid being called on
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will think I am not good enough, incompetent.

special_situations.event: Interacting with unfamiliar people at Social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not witty and funny, reacting poorly, the other will not like me and criticize me inwardly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding socializing activities or 'showing up but not participating', trying not to draw attention
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must be picking on me behind my back.

special_situations.event: Recalling the experience of a joke falling flat at a party years ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One embarrassment is enough to prove I am an embarrassing/clumsy person, and everyone will always remember it and evaluate me accordingly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated rumination and self-labeling, avoiding trying Humor or speaking up in public
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That time already 'defined' me as an embarrassing person; everyone still remembers and mocks me.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted, seen positively, and regarded as a capable person
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being humiliated, negated, and Being rejected (worrying others remember and laugh at her mistakes)
defense_goal: Avoiding the shame brought by external evaluation through Avoiding socializing and lowering presence
Using self-reproach and preemptive Self-denial to 'strike first', lessening possible external blame

object_relations.self_representation: An awkward, embarrassment-prone 'embarrassed person / not good enough person' who may be exposed at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Critical judges, others waiting to catch mistakes and negate people

manifestations: Fearing judgment and Avoiding socializing or lowering presence, struggling to build deep connections
Even with close friends, finds it hard to talk about true distress due to shame
outcomes: Not daring to speak in Work meetings, declining professional engagement

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Expressing tension but cautious cooperation at the start of sessions, frequently self-evaluating 'I am not good enough / I am so embarrassed'
Over-monitoring her own words and deeds in social situations, trying not to draw attention to avoid being judged

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Repeatedly assuming others 'criticize me inwardly' 'think I am no good' in narratives
Attributing inner shame and Self-denial experiences to others' negative views

positive_force: Strong motivation for treatment, positive attitude, willing to complete exercises and change thinking patterns
Able to identify 'evidence-lacking' automatic assumptions, having some self-Reflection ability
Has a few close friends to rely on as potential support
Has tried self-help methods such as breathing exercises, with some self-help experience
negative_force: Mind reading of others' evaluations and predicting the future, catastrophic / overgeneralizing thinking patterns
Self-labeling and self-reproach, over-relying on external evaluation to determine self-worth
Avoidance maintaining Anxiety (speaking little / not participating socially)
High vigilance in social situations leading to Sleep and self-care being affected
Work pressure and insecurity easily becoming triggers

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance and reduced speaking in social and work settings
antecedent: Being called on or needing to speak in work meetings
Interacting with strangers or unfamiliar people
Being in scenes of being watched or evaluated (gatherings/public occasions)
target_behavior.core_reason: Years-ago embarrassing experience and the resulting conditional link of 'being negatively judged'; catastrophic expectations of imperfection and high dependence on external evaluation
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the shame and Anxiety caused by being evaluated, gaining short-term safety
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired Work performance, limited social participation, superficial Interpersonal relationships, further reinforcing Self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and rumination in social situations (with Declining sleep and self-care)
antecedent: Recalling the old experience of a party going silent
As social events or important meetings approach
Feeling of being evaluated when interacting with strangers
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent rumination and vigilance driven by negative automatic thoughts (mind reading, overgeneralization, catastrophizing)
target_behavior.function: Gains a subjective sense of control of 'being well prepared / avoiding making the mistake again' through excessive worry and rumination
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty falling asleep and fatigue increase, self-care declines, and social and work performance the next day are further impaired
